ns2:section.sectionText: HORT455 cannot be applied toward the Off-campus M.S. degree in NRES. It is only applicable to the off-campus B.S. degree completion degree in Horticulture. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. No class during the week of Thanksgiving Break-November 26st. This is a blended format course containing face to face sessions as well as online sessions using Elluminate (www.elluminate.com). Students will be required to have high speed internet, working microphone and speakers for this course. Face to face sessions in Oak Brook on 8/27, 9/3, 9/10, 9/17, 9/24, 10/15, 11/5, 12/10. Elluminate sessions on 10/1, 10/8, 10/22, 10/29, 11/12, 11/19, 12/3.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign AO Fees 2+4 $41.00 per Bill Hour, and Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign AO Tuition 2+4 $305.00 per Bill Hour.
